Metadata.title: InviteFlow — Digital Invitations & Event Tickets
Metadata.description: A platform for digital invitations, RSVP tracking, and event ticketing.

hero.subtitle: A complete platform for digital invitations, RSVP polls, and event ticketing — simple, and fully professional.
hero.guestLink: Or try it as a guest, no sign-up ←

trustStrip.item1Label: Guests never open a separate link
trustStrip.item4Label: Your data is protected in the database

invitation.title: Digital Invitation
invitation.tagline: Design unique invitations and share them with your guests easily
invitation.bullet1: Accept or decline with one tap, right inside WhatsApp
invitation.bullet2: No questions, no clutter — just the details that matter

ticketing.title: Ticketed Event
ticketing.tagline: Sell tickets, manage entry, and professional QR codes
ticketing.bullet1: Ticket tiers with your own prices and quantities
ticketing.bullet3: Check-in attendees with a QR scan

rsvp.title: Polls & RSVP
rsvp.tagline: Collect attendance responses and survey your guests
rsvp.bullet2: Sent directly to specific phone numbers
rsvp.bullet3: Instant results you can broadcast to everyone

why.title: Why InviteFlow?
why.statement: Built from the ground up for Arabic-speaking users — not a translated foreign tool.
why.point1: Guests reply right inside WhatsApp — never opening a link at all
why.point2: Real online payment for ticket sales
why.point3: Every guest gets their own edit link, no account needed
why.point4: Your data is protected by row-level security in the database
